title: Review source permissions, survival balance and full-experience decisions

## Human actions
1. Source rights: inspect the exact production manifest/query/source IDs and current full ESA Gaia, JPL and NASA Exoplanet Archive terms, contributed references and credits. Record intended private/distribution scope, exact approved inputs/hashes, credits/permission evidence and actual reviewer/date. Preserve restricted/unreviewed rejection until explicit review; cloud automation cannot infer permission. Return a decision record; missing full terms/snapshots remain blockers.
2. Balance: use #568's worksheets/raw reproduction. On any suitable playable machine run real discovery/setup/gather/return/intake/Fabricator/collection/Q routes (normal and low health/fatigue, obstacles and poor layouts). Capture active intervals, resource identities, funding, screen/video and state/logs. Do not count fixture placement or starter resources as measured acquisition. Compare proposed 360s comfort and 720s break-even ration routes; explicitly accept/revise scope and tuning without silently changing approved meter durations or biomass distribution.
3. Full experience: after #469–#475/#471 and real backend prerequisites, perform the playable opening/story/Hall experience and accessibility review, including distinct leads, wormhole ambiguity, spoiler absence and durable unlock/return. Record actual blocked/unrun routes. #568 owns machine-executable integration/backend tests; #561 owns image/audio review.
4. Return this issue URL, checklist, originals/logs/hashes, machine context, reviewer/date and explicit decisions to Codex. Codex updates the issue and creates a PR for changed docs/data/code/evidence, or directly closes a complete evidence-only decision when no repository change is needed.

## Automation and dependencies
Automatable corpus/hosted-or-local capture, matrix and balance reproduction move to #568. Source permission/full snapshot and future implementation/backend blockers remain. Reference M1 access is not required for source review, product decisions or general human gameplay review; any actual M1 performance claim remains #563. Historical results and restrictions below are preserved.
## Historical scope and evidence (preserved)
The text below records the previous scope/evidence. Its M1-only completion language is superseded above; substantive feature constraints and failures are retained.

<summary>Original issue specification and delivery links</summary>

Closing the original issues records delivery and transfer of remaining scope; it does not approve images, data rights, balance or native/backend behavior.

- [ ] U07 #408 and U12 #413 production ingestion/publication follow this issue's gate after #513 closes. Private fixture science and independent implementation may continue.

Delivered: fresh six-test portable balance reproduction and raw availability JSON; retained 941.304-second net-negative ration route, slow-setup miss of proposed 360-second comfort target, and missing sampled biomass on Moon/Mars/Mercury/Venus.
